name: Mailchimp
description: Email marketing platform with a Marketing API for campaigns and a Transactional (Mandrill) email/SMS API.
auth_notes: OAuth 2 supported for connected apps; API keys are generated by account Admins. Both are described only in partner-program and third-party text, not first-party reference pages.
gate_detail: API keys require an Admin user role; OAuth apps are authorized by the account owner. Whether a free plan suffices is not stated. The Integration Partner Program is free but reviewed (4-6 weeks), and is optional for building.
api_scope: Marketing API for campaigns and audience data pulled from an app; Transactional (formerly Mandrill) sends event-driven email and SMS via API or SMTP.
mcp_notes: Sources do not mention any MCP server.
blocker_detail: Admin role needed for API keys; free-plan sufficiency and first-party credential steps are not shown in the sources.

evidence.quote: Mailchimp’s Marketing API powers timely, relevant marketing campaigns with custom data pulled directly from your app.
An Admin has those same rights but can also manage billing, connect integrations, and create API keys.
Mailchimp supports OAuth 2.0 for connected apps
No. Membership is free of charge.

issues: Developer credential steps are not stated on first-party pages; the API key and Admin details come from a third-party blog.
Free plan versus paid plan requirement is not established.
REST style, webhooks, sandbox and MCP are not stated in the sources.
